implementation: The verifier parses committed android/** and test-apps/** gradle.lockfile entries scoped to *ReleaseRuntimeClasspath configurations and applies a documented best-effort denylist of known networking coordinates.
The verifier separately reports, but excludes from the Android-runtime claim, tooling/tracebox-gradle-plugin's JVM build-time runtimeClasspath.

httpclient_provenance.result: org.apache.httpcomponents:httpclient:4.5.14 is pulled by com.android.tools.analytics-library:crash:32.2.0, which is transitive from com.android.tools.build:gradle:9.2.0. The plugin declares implementation("com.android.tools.build:gradle:9.2.0") in tooling/tracebox-gradle-plugin/build.gradle.kts. This is the JVM Gradle plugin's build-time runtimeClasspath; it is not a dependency packaged into the phase0-fixture release Android artifact.

implementation: tbdiag-cli rejects encrypted (bit 0) and data-descriptor (bit 3) general-purpose flags in both central and local headers with typed errors.
It cross-checks local versus central flags, method, CRC-32, compressed size, uncompressed size, and filename before copying payload bytes.
It calculates IEEE ZIP CRC-32 over bounded STORED payload slices and rejects a mismatch with ArchiveError::CrcMismatch.
